testResults.name: bicep-and-workflow-validation
testResults.command: az bicep build --file infra/modules/container-registry.bicep && uv run --with pyyaml python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/prune-acr.yml')); yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/deploy-main.yml'))"
testResults.result: Bicep compiles with the retention policy (properties.policies.retention, retentionDays default 7 matching the rollback window, range 7-90, retentionStatus default enabled); both workflows parse cleanly; no live Azure mutations performed (AC5)

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2184 passed, 13 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze; no Python runtime changes in this task

limitations: ACR registry-level retention policies are Premium-SKU-only and cover untagged manifests; tag-carrying mirrored digests are pruned by the per-service prune-acr.yml workflow, which keeps the newest two digests plus every digest referenced by an active or traffic-bearing Container App revision, job template images, and mutable-tagged digests
The scheduled and post-deploy prune paths require a live run to record deletion evidence; the workflow is wired to deploy-main (acr-retention job) and workflow_dispatch
